title: Fire Fighters prep
author: Johnny
desc: Program to prepare you for the unique effort of firefighting. Legs, Lungs and rotational power are essential

ex.note: If you can do 10 unassisted pull ups you can begin doing them unassisted AMRAP

ss.note:
Kettlebell swing needs to be heavy please drop weight for clean and press

10 each arm
Use clean and press weight
Use same weight as the swings
Use kettlebell and get on one knee do 6 each side go from hip to just above shoulder and look the direction of the kettlebell twisting your body
10 each arm

ex.note: Suitcase carry kettlebell or dumbbell on one side do 10 lunges switch arms and another 10
Most people don’t go heavy on biceps but it’s very necessary for functional strength
Go heavy and use good form powerful arms will never disappoint you
You can just use the reverse pec deck
This is for the short head of the tricep so use good form arms
Actually train your calves with effort they are extremely important for athleticism
Do these behind the back and also train them with effort grip is literally your lifeline
Eventually you will want to do your 20 minutes with a 50lb weighted vest. Your oxygen bottle will last 20 minutes and your air pack is 50lbs you’re going to want it to be able to get to 40 mins too
